svg.title: GitHub ephemeral runners on AWS Lambda MicroVMs - architecture overview
svg.text: GitHub ephemeral runners on AWS Lambda MicroVMs
One workflow job → one single-use MicroVM, chosen by a runner-profile label (arm64 | x86_64 × plain | Docker × small | medium | large).
App JWT → installation token → JIT runner config
runner registers with GitHub (JIT) and runs exactly one job
